title: Row houses on East 139th Street in falling snow
description: A row-house street during a snowfall, looking along the sidewalk. On the left a continuous terrace of red brick houses runs into the distance, with pale stone lintels over the windows and bracketed cornices at the roofline; each house has a stoop with iron and stone railings, all of them under several inches of snow. A narrow path has been shovelled down the middle of the sidewalk and a single figure in a dark coat and backpack walks away from the camera along it. A bare tree still holding brown leaves stands at the kerb, and snow-covered cars and a van are parked at the right, with taller buildings beyond them under a white sky.
author: Amolina196
